parameters.description:
Relay a message through your own Parse Platform by posting a native Parse Platform payload to the UnitySVC gateway.

`parseplatform-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `parseplatform` payload. The gateway composes the upstream Parse Platform URL from your stored secrets, injects your credential header, and forwards the request, so your credentials never leave the platform.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `plus` channel binds an extra per-enrollment credential via enrollment parameters.

api_key_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's API key
